name: Flex Import
author: flextheme

sections.description:
Flex Import is a powerful one-click demo importer plugin built to supercharge your website setup experience. Developed by the team at Flex Theme, this plugin lets you launch stunning websites in seconds with pre-designed templates, widgets, and recommended plugins — all seamlessly integrated.

⚡ Want even more power and customization? Upgrade to the Flex Pro WordPress Theme for access to premium templates, advanced widgets, and full-featured demo content.

Live Demo : Flex Pro WordPress Theme Demo

Flex Import works hand-in-hand with your Flex Theme subscription to deliver a smooth setup process. With a user-friendly dashboard inside WordPress, it gives you instant access to demos, plugins, and layout options for various industries — perfect for both beginners and experienced users.

Key Features

  • One-Click Demo Import: Instantly load pages, layouts, settings, and content.

  • Auto Plugin Activation: Automatically installs all required plugins.

  • Centralized Dashboard: Manage templates, widgets, and support in one place.

  • Free + Premium Widgets: Customize your site with high-converting elements.

  • Automatic Template Updates: Stay current with latest designs and performance tweaks.

  • Mobile Responsive: Fully optimized for all screen sizes.

  • Support Integration: Contact support directly from your dashboard.

  • Subscription Controls: View, manage, and upgrade your Flex Theme plan easily.

Flex Import also connects securely with our server’s API to pull in JSON-based demo data and pre-coded layouts — making setup smooth, fast, and secure.
Launch your next website with confidence using Flex Import — and unlock the full power of design with Flex Pro.

External services

This plugin integrates with our server’s API to provide seamless JSON-based data communication. Additionally, it includes a demo import feature that fetches and writes pre-coded demo files directly to your WordPress installation for a smooth setup experience.

The server API and demo import are utilized to enhance the functionality of your WordPress site by automating data handling and demo content integration. All data interactions are secure and comply with standard best practices.

This service is provided by “Flextheme”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload via WordPress Admin
o Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
o Search for Flex Import and click Install Now.
o Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin.

2. Manual Upload
o Download the Flex Import plugin zip file from the WordPress.org repository.
o In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
o Choose the flex-import.zip file, click Install Now, and then Activate.

3. Using Flex Import
o Upon activation, you will be prompted to install the Flex Theme. If you haven’t installed it yet, follow the on-screen instructions.
o After theme installation, open the Flex Import Dashboard from your WordPress menu.
o Browse available templates, plugins, and widgets, and select the demo content you wish to import.
o Click Import Demo and let Flex Import handle the rest. Your site will be populated with demo content, settings, and required plugins within moments.
